hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] && [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx) npx eslint --fix "$f"; sed -i '' '/^[[:space:]]*$/d' "$f" ;; esac; npx prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
hooks.statusMessage: Formatting with eslint/prettier and stripping blank lines...
